# **✍️ Quick notes**  

## **Mexico - Back Office**

  

Sep 3, 2026

[Jaqueline Sanches](mailto:jaqueline.sanches@draiver.com) [Juliana Turin](mailto:juliana.turin@driverdo.com) [Armando Flores](mailto:armando.flores@driverdo.com) [Rafael Pagliuso De Andrade](mailto:rafael.andrade@driverdo.com) [Cristhian Herrera](mailto:cristhian.herrera@draiver.com) [Julia Diaz](mailto:julia.diaz@draiver.com) [Paulo Ferrato](mailto:paulo.ferrato@draiver.com)

  

Compensation restructuring debated and accounting vendor proposals evaluated for operational efficiency via strategic cost analysis

  

## **Personnel Structure and Compensation**

  - Decided to maintain overtime pay for on-site staff, justified by the requirement for daily office presence.
  - Proposed implementing an 'essential workers' policy to distinguish between on-site and remote employee compensation expectations.
  - Agreed to utilize distinct job titles and separate team structures to ensure activities remain non-overlapping.
  - Targeting October 1st as the official transition start date to streamline payroll.
  - Life insurance offering is pending final quotes, expected by the end of September.

  

## **Accounting and Invoicing Supplier Evaluation**

  - Evaluated CAM as a high-quality firm with strong experience in tax, accounting, and gig economy regulations.
  - Established that the current accounting provider (Outing) costs approximately 49,000 MXN monthly, excluding erroneous rent charges.
  - Expressed concern regarding the complexity and integration risks of pairing a separate technology platform (Ole) with a secondary accounting firm.
  - Recommended negotiating fees with CAM as the primary path forward rather than pursuing a split-supplier strategy.
  - Debated the necessity of maintaining the current invoicing supplier against the high costs of the proposed driver stamping solutions.

  

## **Office Infrastructure**

  - Identified that current rental arrangements involve unnecessary payments to the existing accounting provider.
  - Agreed to coordinate with the Kabak team to allocate an on-site office room, eliminating external rental costs.

  

## **Next steps**

  - \[Jaqueline Sanches\] Update Offers: Modify all offer letters to include distinct job titles for the new team members.
  - \[Jaqueline Sanches\] Inquire Computers: Contact Rosio to confirm the logistics for providing company computers to the team.
  - \[Jaqueline Sanches\] Propose Bonus Change: Ask Rosio about the possibility of transitioning the bonus structure from monthly to quarterly payments.
  - \[Jaqueline Sanches\] Set Start Date: Request October 1 as the official transition start date to simplify payroll and operations.
  - \[Jaqueline Sanches\] Schedule Meeting: Organize a follow up call with Rosio to review updated documentation and finalize transition steps.
  - \[Juliana Turin\] Request Office Space: Reach out to the Kabak team to coordinate the allocation of an office room within their facility.
  - \[Cristhian Herrera\] Verify Accounting Data: Re-examine the accounting and invoicing comparison data to ensure accuracy before selecting a supplier.
  - \[The group\] Negotiate Contract: Engage with CAM to negotiate the terms and service fees of the proposed accounting contract.
  - \[Armando Flores\] Determine Altaz Process: Define the local procedure for handling the altaz requirement.
  - \[Armando Flores\] Detail Movement Costs: Calculate and present the cost breakdown per movement based on current proposals.
  - \[Armando Flores\] Document Stamping Process: Create a step-by-step explanation for the factoring and seaf stamping procedures to ensure clarity.

Armando Flores counters that paying extra hours to some employees while others receive nothing could cause internal conflict, citing Uriel as someone who might demand extra money for working Sundays, and suggests restricting the policy to essential workers or those going to Lerma daily ([00:02:34](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a_3PDmUVnlGPoQYGlN8hetR_1X2lQfnoT2yQ9mJd0Fw/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.j4nws162fpv4)).
